name: Fleetboard (changes)
description:
Fleetboard changes that Erynne or Claude may **propose**: add a host, rename one, pause or resume its monitoring, remove it, or set a threshold. None of them runs until a person presses **Run it**. Every one is audited in Fleetboard as *Mnemerynne/Claude (token …)* with the reason the proposal carried, and shows in the read-only **Fleetboard** API's *Activity*. Keep **Fleetboard** for questions; this one is only for changes.

Nothing here runs commands on a machine: Fleetboard's clients have no write routes, and these change only Fleetboard's own host list and thresholds.

**Setup**

1. On the Mnemerynne box make a separate token that may act: `sudo -u fleetboard fleetboard-server token add mnemerynne-act --scope act`. It is printed once. Paste it here as the credential (Bearer).
2. No certificate: plain http on loopback.
3. Set the AD group to IT (whoever may change monitoring).
4. On **Remove host**, tick **Needs an admin's approval**: it deletes the host and all its history and can't be undone. Consider it for **Set threshold** too, since thresholds also drive the Wazuh disk and offline alerts.
5. Test on a spare host. Testing a change really makes it.
6. Leave Claude's switch off until you've tried it from Erynne's chat.

Revoke with `sudo -u fleetboard fleetboard-server token revoke mnemerynne-act`.

operations.name: Hosts
operations.description: Every host with its id, name, address and status (up, down, paused). Check it before proposing a change: actions take the host's id.
example_questions: What is the Fleetboard id of rsync-box?
Is the NAS paused in Fleetboard?

operations.name: Thresholds
operations.description: The current limits and their allowed ranges, to check before proposing Set threshold.
example_questions: What is Fleetboard's disk threshold now?

operations.name: Add host
operations.description: Start watching a machine. Fleetboard checks first that the address answers with the shared client token, and refuses (nothing saved) if it doesn't, with the reason.

params.name: address
params.help: host or IP, with :port if not 9280

params.name: reason
params.help: Why; goes in Fleetboard's audit log

operations.name: Rename host
operations.description: Change a host's display name in Fleetboard.

operations.name: Pause monitoring
operations.description: Stop polling a host and stop its alerts (e.g. during planned work). Its history stays. Refused if it is already paused.

params.name: reason
params.help: Why, e.g. the maintenance it's for

operations.name: Resume monitoring
operations.description: Poll a paused host again. Fleetboard checks first that it answers.

operations.name: Remove host
operations.description: Stop watching a machine and delete all its history (24 h of samples, 7 days hourly, 90 days daily). Can't be undone; pausing keeps the history.

operations.name: Set threshold
operations.description: Change one limit: disk_pct (50-99), disk_critical_pct (50-100, above disk_pct), mem_pct (50-100), temp_c (40-120) or offline_minutes (1-1440). It changes what Over thresholds reports and when the Wazuh disk and offline alerts fire.

params.name: value
params.help: The new value (each limit has its own range)
